narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed across Middle Tennessee during the morning hours on July 9. Heavy rainfall from these thunderstorms led to a localized flooding report.
ev: A group of 23 kayakers had to be rescued due to flash flooding on Shoal Creek near Iron City, but no one was injured.
lsr: 23 PEOPLE WERE TRAPPED ALONG SHOAL CREEK NEAR IRON CITY
